title: Crouzeix’s conjecture
statement: For every complex square matrix A and polynomial p, ||p(A)||₂≤2·max{|p(z)|: z is in the numerical range W(A)}.

counterexample.description: Find rational \(A,p\) with \(\lVert p(A)\rVert_2>2\max_{z\in W(A)}\lvert p(z)\rvert\). Singular-value bounds plus interval global optimization or quantifier elimination certify the maximum.
